recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF) and use black (#000000) sans-serif text throughout; make only the four threshold headers bold.
2. Add the chart title text 'ROC Curve for Same Model -different thresholds' in black sans-serif at the top of the right ROC panel (x=65-95% width, y=0-70% height).
3. Draw one vertical blue (#0000FF) divider line at x=35% from the left edge, spanning the full slide height.
4. Place the Threshold=0.0 panel in the top-left position (x=0-35% width, top of the left column): red-bordered bold header box with 'Threshold=0.0'; below it, a 2x2 table with red borders and white cell fills, header row 'Predicted as | P | N', row 'Actual P' = 5 | 0, row 'Actual N' = 6 | 0; immediately to the right of the table, add 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=6/(6+0)=1'.
5. Place the Threshold=0.1 panel second from the top in the left column: red-bordered bold header box with 'Threshold=0.1'; 2x2 red-bordered table with header row 'Predicted as | P | N', row 'Actual P' = 5 | 0, row 'Actual N' = 4 | 2; immediately to the right, add 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=4/(4+2)=0.66'.
6. Place the Threshold=0.3 panel third from the top in the left column: red-bordered bold header box with 'Threshold=0.3'; 2x2 red-bordered table with header row 'Predicted as | P | N', row 'Actual P' = 5 | 0, row 'Actual N' = 2 | 4; immediately to the right, add 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=2/(2+4)=0.33'.
7. Place the Threshold=0.4 panel at the bottom of the left column: red-bordered bold header box with 'Threshold=0.4'; 2x2 red-bordered table with header row 'Predicted as | P | N', row 'Actual P' = 4 | 1, row 'Actual N' = 1 | 5; immediately to the right, add 'TPR=4/(4+1)=4/5' and 'FPR=1/(1+5)=0.16'.
8. Leave the center strip (x=35-65% width, full height) blank white, and add the mouse cursor arrow near the center at approximately x=50% width, y=50% height.
9. In the right ROC panel (x=65-95% width, y=0-70% height), draw a scatter plot with a light cyan plot area (#E6F3FF), black grid lines, black axis arrows, y-axis label 'TPR', and x-axis label 'FPR'. Plot four red (#FF0000) circular points on a 0-1 scale using the coordinates derived from the equations: '0.3' at (FPR=0.33, TPR=1), '0.1' at (FPR=0.66, TPR=1), '0.0' at (FPR=1, TPR=1), and '0.4' at (FPR=0.16, TPR=0.8). Put each label in a white (#FFFFFF) box with black text next to its point. Add a yellow (#FFFF00) circle with black text '32' at the top-right corner of this panel.
10. In the bottom-right panel (x=65-95% width, y=70-95% height), place a light blue (#CCE5FF) formula box on the left containing exactly 'TPR = TP / (TP + FN)' and 'FPR = FP / (FP + TN)'.
11. To the right of that formula box, place the color-coded confusion matrix legend table: header row 'Predicted as | P | N'; row 'Actual P' = TP in a green (#00AA00) cell | FN in a red (#FF0000) cell; row 'Actual N' = FP in a red (#FF0000) cell | TN in a green (#00AA00) cell; use black text.
12. Keep all remaining areas white and add no content beyond the elements listed above.
